messages:
amy: Kickoff — LimeBridge wants to swap from CompetitorX to Redwood. They care about prompt/response parity, token billing diffs, and SSO/KMS. POC next week, who can own?

devin: I can own infra. Need their sample traffic + model family. What's their SLA for throughput/latency?

amy: They're aiming for 300 qps steady, spike to ~1200 for batch jobs. Model family: 'open-chat-large'. They also require SSO+SAML and KMS.

samir: For prompt parity I'll run a side-by-side smoke suite. I can replay 500 prompts and flag deltas. Need their prompt set and pass threshold (suggest 95%).

elaine: Security will take the questionnaire. Send the vendor SQ and their residency requirements. Also confirm if they need Private (VPC/on‑prem) or hosted.

poc-bot: POC created: LB-PoC-1711009999. Staging API keys provisioned in Vault (expire in 48h). :robot_face:

amy: Pricing ask: they want migration credits vs a short-term committed discount. Can we offer trial credits for the smoke run?

devin: Hosted: we can do credits. Dedicated capacity needs a month commit. I'll check with finance on a one-off test credit amount and confirm.

samir: Note: our streaming runtime has slightly different stop-token behavior vs CompetitorX. Add client-side finalization (strip trailing token) to acceptance criteria. I'll include a suggested client patch snippet.

amy: @elaine they sent a snippet of the SQ: `Q12: data retention`. Can you confirm our standard wording for hosted customers?

elaine: Standard: "Redwood does not retain customer prompt/response data by default for hosted customers; optional retention for evals with explicit customer consent." I'll paste approved wording to the doc.

devin: Network request: Ops needs inbound IP allowlist for staging. Ask them to whitelist `34.200.12.45/32` and `34.200.12.46/32`.

amy: Will do. Ops also asked for an estimator of tokenization deltas so billing expectations are clear.

samir: I'll produce a tokenization delta report + sample mismatch examples by EOD Friday. Smoke run scheduled Tue 10:00am PT.

poc-bot: Reminder: smoke run LB-PoC-1711009999 scheduled for 1711450000 (Tue 10:00 PT).

amy: :thumbsup: Thanks all — I'll send the invite to LimeBridge and attach SSO/KMS checklist + the security wording.
